metadataProvider.name: Forest Station, Field Science Center for Northern Biosphere, Hokkaido Univ.

general.abstract: Tomakomai Experimental Forest (TOEF) was established in 1904, as a field of research and education about forest science. The forest covers 2,715ha of lowland area near the Tomakomai city, and it has been used as a study site in various field of research and education for many years.
